lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of four to five identifiable horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters positioned between the branchial region and the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical regions of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features are visible running horizontally across the flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, dark linear object is visible trailing from the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin; minor irregularities and small notches are present on the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of several small, high-chroma yellow pixel regions (indicative of associated teleost fish) is localized near the proximal upper surface of the left pectoral fin.
